notes: ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.thewhitecompany.com/robots.txt) explicitly allows Anthropic-AI and does not block /Bedroom, /Home, /Baby-and-Children, /Christmas category paths, only checkout/account/bag. Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate=chrome120) worked for homepage, robots.txt, uk-sitemap.xml, sitemap_Category.xml (366 category URLs) and for reading breadcrumb/category_id + an embedded 'initialItems' JSON blob used to identify page content/classification. However that JSON blob is only an unlabelled partial product list (no explicit total-count field, includes per-colour sku variants), so it was not used for qty. Escalated to tier (b) Playwright (headless chromium, wait_until=domcontentloaded + 4-5s settle, since 'networkidle' timed out on this site's persistent analytics beacons) to read the rendered '<N> Items' / 'Showing X of X' header on each category page, which is the site's own exact, explicitly displayed count. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. TREE: union of sitemap_Category.xml (366 URLs) plus each candidate page's own breadcrumb (universal_variable.breadcrumb in page HTML) to confirm parent hierarchy; the mega-menu itself is not present in the raw SSR HTML (client-hydrated with no menu markup server-side) so the sitemap + breadcrumb union served as the navigation source per STEP 2. Every leaf's rendered h1/breadcrumb was confirmed to match the requested slug. QTY: rendered '<N> Items' text from the Playwright DOM snapshot of each leaf page (evidence recorded per row); 0 was recorded only where the page explicitly rendered '0 Items' (Cotton & Sateen Bedding, Children's Christmas Stockings - both real, filterable listing pages, just out of stock/season at time of check). EXCLUDED and why: /uk/Bedroom/c/bedroom-new (new-in landing, not a distinct product type), /uk/Bedroom/c/hot-water-bottles (primary product is a hot-water-bottle/heating device, fabric cover is not the primary product type per textile.md material rule), /uk/c/cotbed-duvets (sitemap-listed but rendered with no breadcrumb, no filters, no product grid or item count - not a functioning category page, likely stale/orphaned sitemap entry), /uk/Home/Bathroom/c/wash-bags (personal toiletry-carrying bags, same boundary as excluded Handbag/Travel Bag examples in storage.md #6, not home textile or home storage), /uk/Home/Bathroom/c/bathroom-accessories ('Bathroom Accessories & Storage' - sampled 38 products, only ~8 are storage/laundry-basket items, the large majority are decorative bath accessories (trinket dishes, toothbrush holders, trays, soap dishes, mirrors) so primary product type is Decorative Home Accessories, out of scope for this task), /uk/Home/Kitchen-and-Dining/c/kitchen-accessories and .../picnicware (mixed serveware/kitchenware buckets; only a couple of textile items such as tea towels/oven gloves are buried inside a majority-K&D bucket with no separate textile-only URL), /uk/Baby-and-Children/Childrens-Bedroom/c/nursery (mixed bucket of furniture/decor/textile/toys under a room-name landing page, no single primary product type), /uk/Baby-and-Children/Childrens-Bedroom/c/bedroom-accessories (0 items, name too generic to classify), /uk/Home/Furniture/c/wardrobes-and-storage, chest-of-drawers, cabinets, bathroom-cabinets-and-units (all explicitly under the site's own /Home/Furniture/ path, so classified as Furniture per storage.md #21/#27, out of scope). Bedroom 'Duvet-Covers/Double,Single,King,Super-King,White' and 'Duvets/10-5-tog,King-Size,...' sitemap URLs are size/tog facet pages of the already-recorded Duvet Covers / Duvets categories, not distinct navigational subcategories, so were not recorded separately (would duplicate/fragment the parent qty). All Sale/Offers/Last-Chance-To-Buy/Gifts/Home-Collections/Furniture-Collections/Clothing/Candles-and-Fragrance/Beauty-and-Spa pages and the many '-cs' suffixed cross-sell URLs in the sitemap were excluded as promotional, cross-sell, or out-of-scope (furniture/lighting/decor/fragrance/apparel) per rule.
